Kapaʻa (Kauaʻi dialect: Tapaʻa) is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Kauaʻi County, Hawaiʻi, United States. It is the most populous town in the island of Kauai with a total population of 11,652 as of the 2020 census, up from 9,471 from the 2000 census.
Kapaʻa is a Hawaiian adjective meaning "solid".
